title: State dependent terminal output
statement: For an emitter state $q$ and a finite Boolean word $w$, process its bits in order using the emitter state transition, starting in state $q$. Emit an input bit exactly when the current state is $o$, and emit it unchanged; the resulting word consists of the emitted bits.
